what: Shell rule uses file-scope external_prepare_codex_auth presence instead of per-invocation wiring
scenario_or_breakage: A file can call external_prepare_codex_auth once yet launch codex exec without ${CODEX_AUTH_ARGS[@]}; harness only tests helper-referencing files pass, so OPENAI_API_KEY preference can regress undetected (e.g. run-negotiation-round.sh codex branch)
suggested_fix: Tighten rule (a): flag each non-comment codex exec line unless it is inside launch-codex-exec.sh, carries a pragma, or the same function/block also expands CODEX_AUTH_ARGS immediately before exec; drop file-scope helper-presence bypass
